maria (PM): opening a short decision thread for the priority allocator — we need a deterministic, debuggable rule for admitting reserved-pool requests when a pool is contentioned. want to finalize before next sprint.

maria (PM): high level proposal: a decision lattice combining (1) SLA tier, (2) route latency-sensitivity tag, (3) burst-intent window, (4) recent quota burn rate. output: admit / queue / preemptable.

jon (Eng-Platform): +1 to lattice approach. can we keep the runtime check cheap? prefer bitmask tags rather than scanning many signals.

deepa (SRE): also add a fused signal for recent tail-latency regressions (1m p99 spike). if a tenant caused regressions, deprioritize even if SLA high.

ryan (Product Ops): from customer POV: two asks — 1) opt-in explicit "guaranteed" flag for truly latency-critical tenants, 2) transparent reason code for denied requests (so customer console can show why).

maria (PM): noted. plan: lattice composed of three tiers: HARD GUARANTEE (explicit flag + SLA Platinum), SOFT GUARANTEE (SLA Gold + latency-tag), OPPORTUNISTIC (everything else). within each tier, we break ties by burst-intent window and burn-rate.

jon (Eng-Platform): implementation sketch: store per-tenant bitflags: {explicit_guarantee, latency_sensitive, burst_intent} + numeric burn_score. admission rule pseudocode:

```
// evaluate lattice top-down
if (explicit_guarantee && pool.available >= req.size) admit
else if (tier == SOFT && burst_intent && pool.can_spare_short()) admit_queue_with_preempt_marker
else if (opportunistic && burn_score < threshold) admit_best_effort
else queue_with_backoff
```

jon (Eng-Platform): will need an efficient short-circuit path in the serving runtime to avoid per-request DB calls. cache bitflags in the routing layer for 5s TTL.

deepa (SRE): preempt behavior must be bounded: max-preempt-per-minute per pool, and learn a cooldown if we see error spikes. otherwise we risk cascading failures.

ryan (Product Ops): for launch acceptance: we need (a) per-tenant reason codes surfaced in console, (b) rollout knobs (feature flag per region), (c) acceptance test with 3 tenants simulating bursts and a canary verifying no p99 regressions beyond 5%.

maria (PM): agree. add rollout criteria: telemetry shows no >5% p99 uplift in canary, no more than 2 preempt events per tenant in 24h for alpha tenants, and customer-facing reason codes documented.

capacity-bot: NOTE: pool capacity simulator run scheduled 1755567905 — will produce synthetic burst profiles for validation.

jon (Eng-Platform): one more: tie-breaker between two equal tenants should use recent committed capacity vs ephemeral demand. prefer committed. prevents gaming.

deepa (SRE): also require a circuit breaker: if preempt rate > X or queue latency > Y, disable opportunistic admits for that pool automatically.

maria (PM): action items: jon -> prototype short-circuit evaluator + caching path (spike-free), deepa -> define SRE circuit-break thresholds and cooldown behavior, ryan -> spec reason-code taxonomy and console mapping, i'll draft decision lattice doc and rollout checklist. target: spike-free canary next week.

ryan (Product Ops): ping me when doc is up, i'll coordinate customer opt-ins.

maria (PM): thanks all — keeping this thread as the source of truth. will post doc link when ready. :white_check_mark:
